Ingest monthly/quarterly portfolio disclosures as availability permits, plus top holdings, sectors, concentration, style, duration and credit quality where applicable.
Add debt-fund metrics: duration, yield to maturity, maturity ladder, credit rating mix, downgrade and liquidity risk; label absent fields.
Add fund-of-funds lookthrough / asset-overlap estimates with double-count prevention and coverage scores.
Record exit-load schedules as time-dependent **per purchase lot**; distinguish full and partial redemption.
Add schemes with ELSS lock-in, segregated portfolios, gating, special redemption restrictions, and closed-end windows; disallow impossible redemptions.
Treat dividends/IDCW payouts, reinvestments, splits and scheme mergers as economic flows for total return rather than apparent NAV crashes.

Add decision-time features and evidence, expected distribution with uncertainty, benchmark, costs, risk/return estimates and contraindications.

Carry entry conditions, stop/exit/invalidation, intended holding window, tick/lot/unit precision and paper execution eligibility.
Enforce signal lifecycle `DETECTED -> ELIGIBLE/REJECTED -> APPROVED/SHADOW -> SUBMITTED -> FILLED/PARTIAL/MISSED -> EXITED/EXPIRED`.
Deduplicate repeated alerts without erasing new rule versions or materially changed prices; ensure event-time ordering.
Publish up to five DAILY swing candidates and independent ETF candidate ranks; publish intraday/options signals event-driven without a compulsory trade quota.
Publish daily/weekly MF **allocation recommendations**, not misleading `instant executions`; include cutoffs, lot-level fees, benchmark and unconfirmed NAV status.
Connect researcher/scanner, event ingestion, news and signals to read-only signal generation; never let an LLM send orders directly.
Human decisions may create a separate manual-approved paper sleeve, while an autonomous paper sleeve preserves objective original outcomes.
Store rejected signals and their counterfactual follow-up observations without reclassifying them as actual portfolio P&L.
Distinguish signal quality from execution quality and calendar availability; missing data is an explicit state.
Add typed `EntrySignal` and `ExitSignal`, with UUIDs, explicit `opens_position_id`/`closes_position_id`, strategy/version, instrument, quote-source identity, timestamp and parent signal lineage.

Require every eligible exchange trade to publish side (`BUY`, `SELL_SHORT` where permissible), executable entry limit/zone, signal expiry, size, SL, TP, holding horizon, and conditional exit policies *before* paper entry.
Use closing-side semantics: `BUY -> SELL_TO_CLOSE`; permitted intraday `SELL_SHORT -> BUY_TO_COVER`; multi-leg option spread exits must close the right quantity in every leg.

Define `ExitPolicy` with ordered triggers `HARD_STOP`, `TAKE_PROFIT`, `TRAILING_STOP`, `SIGNAL_REVERSAL`, `TIME_STOP`, `SESSION_FLATTEN`, `RISK_KILL_SWITCH`, `MANUAL_CLOSE`, and `EXPIRY_OR_CORPORATE_ACTION`.
Store stop/target basis and reference (`underlying`, `ETF market quote`, `option executable premium`, `combined option spread value`, `published NAV policy`) so unlike units are never compared.
Define `stop_price`, `target_price`, `stop_type`, `target_type`, `time_to_live`, `expected_fill_price`, `assumed_slippage`, quote timestamp and order/cost basis. Never emit ambiguous bare numbers.
Calculate R-multiple, rupee maximum *planned* loss, gross reward:risk and estimated **net** reward:risk including spread, fees, impact and taxes where modeled. Label any forecast as uncertain.
Support configurable minimum reward:risk and projected net expectancy gates by strategy; require a scientifically defended strategy rule rather than blindly forcing 2:1 targets.

Reject nonsensical plans: long SL >= entry, long TP <= entry, short SL <= entry, short TP >= entry, zero/negative tick prices, or incompatible option expiries, unless an explicitly validated exception is versioned.

Size position using stop-distance risk budget, available cash, contract lot size, notional caps, depth and correlated exposure; mark stop-loss risk as *planned*, never a guaranteed upper bound during gaps.
Make price rounding exchange tick-aware and revalidate economics *after* rounding; enforce regulatory product support for direction/venue and disallow unsupported overnight equity shorts.
Add explicit `NO_TRADE`/`WATCH` when no viable price entry, insufficient quote quality, too much slippage, option spread or fund redemption constraint defeats the plan.
Separate a proposed exit plan from an **emitted exit event**. On entry, persist both the entry and protection intent; when a trigger becomes true, publish a new timestamped SELL/BUY-TO-COVER event.
Implement persistent trigger state machines with partial-fill-aware SL/TP quantity adjustments, no duplicate exits, no overselling and restart-safe trigger evaluation.
Implement OCO-like protection in paper: the first executed stop or target cancels/reduces the sibling target/stop; do not assume a broker-native atomic OCO.
Support configurable full exits, profit scale-outs, breakeven stop moves, trailing stops, partial TP ladders and time stops; make each a versioned rule, not an after-the-fact manual adjustment.
On price gaps through SL/TP, use feasible first available executable bid/ask rather than the trigger price; record gap/slippage and preserve losses beyond planned stop.

On bar-only historical simulation where SL and TP are both touched in one bar and event order is unknown, use conservative adverse-first assumptions or report unresolved; never choose the profitable sequence by hindsight.
On tick feeds, check source/receipt timestamps, quote age, spread, depth and circuit/halts before triggering/filling. `LTP` alone can trigger research alerts but must not fabricate executable fills.
When stop triggers during quote outage or trading halt, persist an unresolved exit intent and alert; do not mark a fictional stop-price fill or silently delete open risk.

Add a per-position ledger of `ENTRY_SIGNAL`, `ENTRY_INTENT`, `ENTRY_FILL`, `STOP/TP_ARMED`, `EXIT_TRIGGER`, `EXIT_INTENT`, `EXIT_FILL`, `POSITION_CLOSED`, each with idempotency key and original snapshot.
Ensure a paper position cannot be opened without a valid exit policy, and is never treated as closed until recorded fill or correctly modeled settlement completes.
For equity swing, generate daily BUY candidates with SL/TP from versioned risk/strategy logic; after entry re-evaluate exits throughout the holding period and on gaps across sessions.
For equity intraday, publish new BUY and permitted short SELL signals from event-driven bars/ticks; evaluate SL/TP continuously and enforce a mandatory EOD flatten with missed-exit escalation.
For ETFs, support long and any separately validated supported trade styles; set SL/TP from exchange market price, not delayed NAV/iNAV, and reject untradeable spreads/volume.

For options, emit the precise `CE/PE`, strike, expiry, token, side, lots, premium entry band, SL/TP premium or risk terms, and underlying/context invalidation; default to long premiums or defined-risk spreads.
For options, monitor bid/ask/depth, premium decay, days-to-expiry, price gaps, volatility and Greeks; simulate exit on executable bid for long options and leg-wise feasible quotes for spreads.

Support multiple fund investment lots, load aging, SIPs, STPs, SWPs, fractional units, lock-ins, minimums and tax-aware action recommendations without inventing same-day NAV fills.

Provide CLI/API targets: `fb signals --with-exits`, `fb positions --protective-orders`, `fb exits --desk all`, `fb paper trades --paired`, `fb paper pnl --by-exit-reason`.
Create table-driven unit tests for long/short stop and target inequalities, tick rounding, R-multiple, fees, expired entries, option contract identity and MF NAV threshold semantics.
Create deterministic price-path integration tests for SL-only, TP-only, both touched in one bar, gap-through-SL, gap-through-TP, trailing stop, partial entry and partial exit.
Create failure tests for stale quotes, feed disconnection, halts, high slippage, no liquidity, repeated ticks, out-of-order events, ledger recovery and duplicate exit submissions.

Evaluate actual net performance by exit reason (SL, TP, trail, time, discretionary) and ablate target/stop rules against simpler exits without rewriting historical decisions.

items.text: Define immutable `RawObservation(source_id, instrument_id, exchange_ts, received_ts, available_at, published_at, revision_id, checksum, entitlement)`.
Create effective-dated instrument universe for NSE/BSE equities, listed ETFs, index options, futures and MF schemes; preserve historical delistings and contract changes.
Define event-time/availability-time dual indexing; do not use a close, filing, NAV or revised report before it was observable.
Implement provider-specific timezone/holiday/half-day/session/circuit/expiry/cutoff calendars; never infer session endings from a constant alone.
Add immutable source snapshots with allowed retention, redistribution status and non-display/licensing provenance for each data class.
Create explicit `USE_ALLOWED`, `UNKNOWN_RIGHTS`, `DENIED` entitlement states and fail closed on unknown permissions for operational market feed consumers.
Develop historical availability ledger for price corrections, dividends, splits, symbol/ISIN changes, index constituent changes and futures roll schedules.
Build point-in-time index membership snapshots and survivorship-safe historical corporate action joins for feature training.
Add option strike, side, underlying, lot, expiry and exact token mappings with effective dates; reject reconstructed fictional listed contracts.
Archive quote bid/ask, depth, OI and last trade separately with timestamp/age and entitlement; never make index level a tradable option price.
Distinguish exchange tick vs broker receipt and clock-skew uncertainty; derive `decision_available_at=max(all input availability times)`.
Implement retriable, idempotent ingesters with watermarks, atomic batches, source correction events and data-quality dashboards.
Build negative test: introduce future publication revisions and assert no prior features, signals or policy rankings change.
Add controlled redaction/deletion and retention periods for exchange-licensed feeds; delete prohibited data without corrupting historical provenance.
Declare market data ingestion unavailable during outages, holidays or unauthorized periods; expose `NO_DATA` and stop policy decisions.
Provide training/validation/test data manifests with as-of cutoffs, raw file hashes, transforms and explicit unavailable source periods.
Prevent normalization, universe filtering and feature selection from fitting on validation/test periods.
Block paper simulation using broker live data where provider terms prohibit it until written interpretation or a permitted source is obtained.
Create canonical `FeatureDefinition` with formula hash, window, market, horizon, input lineage, lag, leakage tests and data type.
Implement streaming OHLCV aggregation for 1m/5m/15m/30m/1h/day with missing-minute flags and completed-bar semantics.
Add price-return, volatility, range, trend, volume participation, gap, session VWAP, breadth and liquidity as separate causal feature families.
Add options IV surface, skew, term structure, Greeks and OI features only where observed quotes/contracts support estimation.
Construct cross-index breadth, constituent concentration, Nifty/BankNifty co-movement and sector relative-strength features with aligned timestamps.
Extract event-availability indicators for NSE/BSE filings, corporate announcements, results, shareholding and financial statement revisions.
Implement cross-sectional sector, size, liquidity, beta and corporate-action neutralization fitted on past samples only.
Keep raw, adjusted and total-return price series separated; enforce dividend and split correctness by arithmetic reconciliation.
Add `FeatureSnapshot` with observation/availability timestamp, feature version, source hashes and missingness masks.
Guard against stale indicator values, forward-filled expired contracts and all market-close-to-open boundary leakage.
Create streaming/offline parity fixtures: same market event prefix must produce same feature values in replay and forward processing.
Apply schema migrations with checksummed transformations and automatic feature lineage invalidation when raw source corrections arrive.
Measure feature stability by date, instrument, regime and provider; surface feature drift before automatic retraining.
Detect proxy leakage (index weights inferred from revised constituents, event timestamps after publication, synthetic corporate-action adjustment).
Store exclusion reasons and instrument eligibility at each timestamp so the learner can model genuine no-trade opportunities.
Make feature computation idempotent and deterministic under out-of-order, duplicate and corrected input events.
Benchmark feature inference latency and memory on realistic multi-index and liquid-stock universes.
Force each learned policy to emit all feature IDs and their availability proof in its decision manifest.
Implement `ResearchAgent`, `HypothesisGenerator`, `ExperimentExecutor`, `Evaluator`, `PolicyRegistry`, `RiskGovernor`, `PaperOperator`, `Auditor` interfaces.
Use one event-sourced learning state machine: `HYPOTHESIS → REGISTERED → TRAINED → OOS_TESTED → SHADOW → FORWARD_CANDIDATE → REVIEWED → RETIRED`.
Keep immutable trial identity over family, instrument universe, horizon, dataset version, feature set, action space, reward, code SHA and cost model.
Separate learning-state writes from portfolio-state writes; research agents must not change cash, fills, ledger balances or release policy.
Model all strategy recommendations as `PROPOSE`, `WATCH`, `NO_TRADE`, `EXIT_PROPOSAL`; ownership gates decide eligibility.
Create reason-coded rejection paths for insufficient sample, leakage, stale data, missing rights, excessive cost and unsafe action.
Expose `PolicyDecision` with probabilities, expected net excess, uncertainty, capacity, risk budget, provenance and available-at clock.
Add freeze windows: retraining cannot mutate currently deployed policy weights, state definitions or reward functions during a session.
Declare learning budgets: CPU/GPU/time/disk/trial counts; budget exhaustion must stop research automatically.
Build human-only permission checks for changing statistical thresholds, capital caps, strategy families, broker flags or protected holdouts.
Create structured machine-readable experiment reports and human-readable economic rationale, with no success claims from test count.
Implement data/reward/protocol contracts as schemas with Pydantic or pure typed validators, pinned by hashes.
Declare deterministic simulation mode and probabilistic training mode with seed registers and reproducibility reports.
Integrate with existing `forward_edge/` claim tiers and ADRs via adapters; no parallel, less strict promotion path.
Implement familywise lineage: descendants share parent discovery-trial budget and cannot reset failure history by renaming.
Include policy abstention and market-close actions in every decision API; forbid forced trades.
Develop kill-switch and audited manual intervention paths that work even if all learning services are unavailable.
Define outcome statuses `FAIL`, `NO_EDGE`, `CANDIDATE`, `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`, `PAPER_CONFIRMED`, never fabricate evidence.
Model the task as a partially observable sequential decision process, not a fully known future price trajectory.
Define state `s_t = (point-in-time market features, holdings, cash, drawdown, orders, remaining time, data health, model uncertainty)`.
Define policy action as abstract desired position/option intent; the risk governor projects it into a feasible trade or NO_TRADE.
Create configurable episode boundaries by instrument/session/month/expiry; no accidental carry across account restarts.
Add event-driven transitions for quote, bar close, trade, fill, cancel, rejection, halt, corporate action, cash flow and model update.
Make market events immutable and independent of policy action except explicitly modeled impact and marketable participation.
Enforce cash availability, whole-share/lot sizing, exchange limits, options expiry, settlement and instrument eligibility on every step.
Support canonical order states `NEW/ACK/PARTIAL/FILLED/CANCELLED/REJECTED/UNKNOWN` with durable write-ahead transitions.
Implement reward event emission at actual valuation events rather than hindsight labeling at entry.
For overlapping SL and TP on the same OHLC candle, choose adverse-first or unresolved; require tick/depth to resolve ordering.
Model bid-ask spread, queue probability, depth depletion, adverse selection, partial fills, stale data and varying latency.
Model session-open gap-through-stop and exchange halt as non-guaranteed stop execution; preserve open risk when impossible to close.
Parameterize exchange fee/tax/impact/participation rules point in time with actual instrument category.
Create historical replay simulator, synthetic stress simulator and prospectively observed paper simulator with different evidence labels.
Allow replay snapshots/rewind of the simulator while preventing the learner from inspecting future scenario random seeds.
Implement deterministic no-trade baseline and fixed-rule policy baselines in exactly the same simulator.
Model stochastic execution uncertainty as scenario distribution; do not equate simulated fills to brokerage executions.
Build differential tests against canonical OMS and ledger at every portfolio transition.
Add impossibility assertions: negative cash without approved margin, fictitious contracts, zero-cost instant fills, fill before quote.
Publish simulator fidelity manifest showing which assumptions are observed, calibrated, conservative or wholly synthetic.
Define step net return from post-cost marked equity, excluding deposits/withdrawals and marking open positions at executable exit-side quotes when possible.
Compute reward using posted ledger costs exactly once: brokerage, STT/CTT if relevant, exchange fees, GST, stamp duty, spread, slippage and measured impact.
Use matched benchmark excess as a separately reported objective; never quietly subtract both benchmark drift and risk penalties twice.
Distinguish gross return, net return, net alpha, downside utility, risk constraint violation and estimation confidence in separate metrics.
Define reward as cumulative portfolio utility rather than average winning trade, win rate, gross P&L or raw price direction.
Use drawdown, CVaR, gross/net exposure, turnover, concentration, margin and liquidity as hard policy constraints before reward optimization.
Add risk penalties to diagnostic objective with frozen coefficients; avoid replacing a failed hard constraint with small negative reward.
Include flat/cash and no-trade periods in equity-curve and Sharpe calculations.
Enforce end-of-episode liquidation using feasible exit-side prices, unsettled states and explicit unknown marks.
Penalize unnecessary churn through realized costs, not an arbitrary fee that might be tuned to hide losses.
Handle option premium, theta/IV, exercise/assignment/expiry and defined-risk spread value in position-based P&L.
Handle futures variation margin, margin requirement and liquidation stress in the simulator, separately from cash-equity bookkeeping.
Handle ETF distributions and MF NAV/exit loads/settlement with asset-specific valuation clocks.
Test zero-price-change high-turnover policies produce negative net P&L under positive costs.
Test rewards cannot be increased by fake wins, reopening after crash, postponing loss realization or ignoring open adverse marks.
Create per-action reward decomposition and per-episode double-entry reconciliation with one source of truth.
Add reward misspecification audit: verify that a higher reward ranking implies better actual defined economic objective on holdout.
Fix reward and risk coefficient versions before each registered experiment; any tuning is a new trial.
Implement current and historical Indian charge schedules as effective-dated configuration with source and date-of-validity tests.
Model intended notional, max participation, per-contract minimum costs and execution delay separately for every asset class.
Calculate execution shortfall relative to the quote legally observed at the decision moment, not to a future midprice.
Build option spread/depth curve and quote staleness filters for exact contract, strike and expiry.
Estimate impact and adverse selection from observed data where available; expose unverifiable estimates as uncertainty intervals.
Use max(optimistic, base, stressed) cost suite in evaluation, with profitability gate requiring defensible robustness.
Apply whole-share rounding and fixed charges to small-account H005/H003/P3 books; test INR 50k, 2L, 10L sensitivity as scenarios, not promises.
Implement cash drag, dividends and idle capital explicitly in monthly equity-book economics.
Simulate rebalance delays and liquidity caps while maintaining unchanged decision-time ranking and point-in-time universe.
Model price-band, lower/upper circuit, expiry day and market-halt cases as rejected or unresolved orders.
Build transaction-cost attribution by brokerage, STT, spread, impact, slippage, exchange fees and market movement.
Construct capacity curves net return versus deployed capital and market participation, with confidence bands.
Add trade scheduling and TWAP/VWAP comparison without assuming one is universally superior.
Compare dynamic execution policies to marketable-limit baseline under same arrival time and quote observations.
Flag strategy whose positive alpha is concentrated in contracts with unknown depth or sample-size-limited liquidity.
Cross-check conservative OHLC fills against tick replay when available; label discrepancy and propagate to uncertainty.
Exhaustively test missing bid/ask, zero depth, stale LTP, spread expansion and illiquid ETF cases.
Require final P&L reproducibility from the raw economic ledger without consulting model-generated text.
Define episode key `(dataset_version, instrument, session_id, strategy_id, behavior_policy_version, account_id)` with immutable clock.
Store full `(s_t, eligible_action_mask, chosen_action, action_probability, fill, reward, s_{t+1}, done, provenance)` rows.
When behavior propensities are unknown, label `PROPENSITY_UNAVAILABLE`; do not create fabricated numbers.
Distinguish replayed hypothetical counterfactual rewards from observed actions and outcomes using separate schemas.
Capture rejected signal, no-trade and abstention opportunities, not only executed winners.
Prevent reconstructing missing live actions as if a previous policy chose them prospectively.
Encode action support set and coverage density by regime/instrument/size; mark unsupported actions as OOD.
Discard data points where unresolved fills, insufficient quote history or legal data retention prevent valid reward.
Build contiguous training trajectories without session/expiry leakage; allow overnight positions only when strategy permits.
Use explicit `action_decision_ts` and `first_eligible_fill_ts`; refuse same-bar perfect entry at future close.
Create behavior-cloning baseline and action-frequency/entropy diagnostic for every historical strategy.
Partition trajectories by chrono fold, correlated index/session group and data source; embargo overlapping holdings.
Store min/max observed position size, leverage, spread, holding time and action support per behavior policy.
Check bias from logging only placed trades; estimate policy support and refuse invalid off-policy comparisons.
Implement deterministic trajectory builder with hash-for-hash reproducibility across OS and CPU architectures.
Build test corruptions: swapped rewards, future fields, missing actions, clock drift, duplicate quotes, missing propensities.
Provide parquet snapshots plus schema and audit manifest; no network use required to replay permitted recorded fixtures.
Document precisely which behavioral datasets are adequate for bandits, supervised predictors, offline RL or none.
Build typed strategy grammar with instrument scope, event trigger, lookback, feature transform, forecast horizon, entry, exit and allowed order action.
Assign every feature and candidate to an economic hypothesis: risk premium, liquidity, behavioral delay, structural demand, event timing or market microstructure.
Require a mechanism statement, predicted direction, horizon, failure regime and falsifying test before candidate construction.
Create AST-based program representation and safe interpreter with bounded expression size, no arbitrary Python, no network and no data mutation.
Expose allowed primitives: rolling rank, decile, lag, volatility, relative-strength, sector neutralization, event age and cross-sectional group.
Add declarative constraints to prohibit future references, invalid implicit joins, lookahead pivots and calendar offsets beyond available data.
Implement algebraic and semantic canonicalization so duplicate strategies share trial identity even if expressions differ syntactically.
Add family similarity clustering by input features, behavior, trades, sector and realized P&L; do not count cloned alphas as independent.
Create static cost upper-bound estimator and minimum tradable-horizon check to reject impossible high-turnover concepts early.
Generate a baseline/null hypothesis paired with every new candidate before any return series is computed.
Define event hypotheses against publication timestamp, not fiscal quarter label or later revised filing.
Define long, short, cash, hedge and options hypotheses with market authorization and paper-specific masks.
Implement crossover/noise/metamorphic tests: future mutation, time reversal, shuffled labels, lagged features and random signs.
Add structural complexity cap, logic-depth cap and portfolio turnover budget; disallow unconstrained genetic-code explosion.
Store raw researcher prompt, generated AST, parent IDs, generated code SHA, economic rationale and cost estimate in append-only manifests.
Detect invalid redundant filters (combining highly correlated momentum transforms) and report effective number of economic ideas.
Implement machine-checkable pre-registration from DSL spec before backtesting any protected candidate.
Add hypothesis audit that returns `NOT_TESTABLE` when required market data or natural experiment does not exist.
Create `IdeaProposal` with mechanism, anticipated return source, feature availability, estimated capacity, relevant desk and proposed falsification.
Use self-generated candidates and stored literature notes strictly as proposals, never as evidence that a return exists.
Implement acquisition priority from economic plausibility, available sample, execution costs, novelty and expected information gain.
Cap candidate generation per family and prevent agent from silently increasing search budgets after failed outcomes.
Use diverse source families: price/volume, filings, financial fundamentals, momentum, liquidity, options microstructure, ETF premiums and corporate actions.
Separate new information sources from new transforms of identical candle patterns; record whether marginal information actually exists.
Create candidate comparison against matched random-book, time-shifted signal, sector-neutral and equal-turnover controls.
Use conditional permutation and targeted ablation to establish which source truly drives any measured gain.
Create candidate-level alternative explanations and a checklist for corporate-action/adjusted-price artifacts.
Measure marginal improvement given existing accepted exposures rather than judging only stand-alone Sharpe.
Detect portfolio alpha duplication via turnover-adjusted correlations and common market/sector factor exposures.
Compute economic break-even spread or fee for each candidate; reject if required execution advantage is unattainable.
Develop isolated sandbox for experiment construction and test generation; deny access to validation/test labels until preregistration.
Automate first-line test reviewer independent of candidate generator; reviewer must attempt to falsify and document defects.
Build failure memory: store why 128 Four-Node variants and other intraday ideas failed; penalize exact repeats, not novel mechanisms.
Provide transparent leaderboard showing proposed, rejected without trial, trained, inconclusive and provisionally positive counts.
Use predeclared holdout sample budgets and cryptographic seals, preserving which candidates have already viewed which periods.
Output explicit `NO_NEW_EDGE_FOUND` if all candidates fail, with no artificial winner selection.
Implement constant CASH, broad-market invest-and-hold, matched momentum, volatility-scaled buy/hold and existing fixed-rule paper baselines.
Implement linear/ridge/logistic predictors with strictly chronological training and comparably normalized inputs.
Implement tree-based supervised model where in-house or existing standard libraries permit reproducible controlled tuning.
Implement probability calibration with walk-forward isotonic/Platt/temperature transforms fitted only on prior validation windows.
Use distributional random-walk, drift and stationary block bootstrap nulls already represented in `forecasting/null.py`.
Compare baseline alpha by asset class, horizon, regime, transaction cost, exposure and signal availability.
Expose confidence bands, forecast calibration and net P&L without conflating predictive skill with tradability.
Make a thresholded forecast-to-trade baseline with cash and all risk gates before RL can claim incremental value.
Implement deterministic buy/hold/sell threshold policy plus fixed stop/target/time-stop for exact apples-to-apples baseline.
Implement fitted Q evaluation for finite discrete action and low-dimensional baseline to test sequential edge feasibility.
Assess achievable advantage under a hypothetical zero-cost upper bound and real base cost; classify marginal patterns cost-dominated.
Test all baselines on the same episodes, same available information, same portfolio size and same policies for unresolved fills.
Prohibit comparing one algorithm trained on 2016–2025 to an inferior baseline trained on older or less complete periods.
Log annualized turnover, cost drag, max drawdown, downside tail risk, factor exposures and fraction of time invested.
Create baseline registry and immutable champion label independent of any new RL training metrics.
Gate entry to deep RL research on demonstrated supervised or simple policy evidence plus realistic sample size.
Define bandit context as predecision regime, forecast, strategy quality, liquidity, costs, portfolio and data-health state.
Define arm set `CASH`, `H005`, `H003`, `P3` plus externally eligible desks only; never force available arms to trade.
Implement epsilon-greedy only for offline benchmark, with actual production/shadow exploration constrained to non-cash observation.
Implement UCB/linear-UCB and Thompson-style contextual selection with uncertainty and capped action probabilities.
Calibrate inverse-propensity and doubly robust estimators only when action probability and support assumptions hold.
Distinguish delayed outcomes: monthly-book reward not available on the next 15-minute bar.
Implement delayed-feedback queues, unique outcome settlement IDs and score updates only after the true evaluation horizon.
Handle missing, censored and invalid observations by pending/unknown status, never zero reward substitution.
Implement `select_arm` with risk governor projection; log whether the proposed action was blocked and why.
Implement deterministic replay plus frozen policy shadow evaluation against equal-weight and best past arm baselines.
Enforce concentration and correlated arm limits; selecting three momentum strategies cannot triple the permitted market bet.
Use confidence-based abstention when top arms have overlapping estimated performance intervals.
Compare regime-conditioned vs global selection with dependence-aware statistical uncertainty and predeclared trial budget.
Test cold start and regime changes; initialize untested arms as unproven rather than artificially optimistic.
Use observation-only shadow randomization where legal and useful; do not create live financial losses for exploration.
Build property test: missing action support prevents invalid OPE and no model gets extra capital for missing data.
Introduce rolling evidence decay only after predeclared calibration; prevent hindsight tuning of recency windows.
Attribute any performance uplift to selection timing versus changing factor exposures or differential costs.
Implement behavior cloning MLP and simple linear imitation baseline on strictly logged feasible actions.
Implement discrete `HOLD/ENTER/REDUCE/EXIT/CASH` environment before continuous position sizing.
Create BC validation metrics: action agreement, calibration, state coverage, policy-induced turnover and economic performance.
Implement state-action occupancy and k-nearest-neighbor or density support estimator to detect OOD chosen actions.
Block offline Q-value inference for unseen option contracts, extreme leverage or unobserved quote regimes.
Implement deterministic fitted Q iteration and fitted Q evaluation on small tabular/linear policy problems before neural versions.
Validate Bellman backup and terminal state math on hand-derived two-step and three-step markets.
Implement safe fallback to behavior policy or CASH when uncertainty or support tests fail.
Compare offline learned policy with behavior cloning and old behavior, not with an irrelevant random-action agent.
Keep deterministic evaluation on logged actions separate from simulator-based counterfactual rollouts.
Use chronological replay buffers and contiguous sequences; no uniform mixing that makes training test regimes indistinguishable.
Split trajectories by decision time and correlated session/account event group; embargo overlapping forward rewards.
Track conservative policy improvement by entire monthly/session portfolio P&L, not only training loss convergence.
Add propensity-sensitive evaluation only for data with legitimate behavior policy logging.
Implement target-network/replay math with numerically stable losses and checkpoint loading tests.
Implement random-label, random-policy and zero-edge market fixtures; any fabricated improvement fails algorithm admission.
Keep offline RL policy in research/shadow until approved by independent OOS and forward economic gates.
Document failure: offline observation data alone cannot determine outcomes of arbitrary new trading actions with fidelity.
Implement CQL-style penalization for value estimates on actions outside logged behavior support; verify Q ranking on toy datasets.
Implement IQL-style expectile state-value regression, in-dataset Bellman targets and advantage-weighted behavior policy extraction.
Implement TD3+BC or BCQ-style action constraints for continuous allocations only if behavior data and compute justify them.
Implement separate value, policy, target and support modules with typed gradients, optimizer state and deterministic seeds.
Use n-step and temporal-difference targets that honor the original session/contract termination, fees and outstanding positions.
Add uncertainty ensemble or bootstrap interval around Q estimates and change capital eligibility based on conservative lower bounds.
Use action masks for tradable instruments, remaining time, max loss, concentration and permitted order types.
Compare CQL/IQL against BC, fitted Q, simpler contextual bandit and deterministic trading baseline on identical samples.
Tune hyperparameters using train/validation only; lock number of configurations and record every failed run.
Check sensitivity to support penalty, expectile, discount factor, reward scale, action discretization and transaction costs.
Include at least one zero-alpha random-walk and one known-alpha seeded toy environment as positive and negative controls.
Use independent environment seeds and trading periods; never select on a single historical market crash or bull market.
Compute performance by volatility regime, market direction, sector, liquidity and capital bucket.
Implement policy collapse detection (constant action, excessive leverage, excessive trading, silent liquidation).
Treat training improvement as optimization progress only, not a claim of real market performance.
Archive all weights, data lineage, optimizer states, model cards and audit findings for every trial.
Implement conservative rejection: if uncertain improvement does not exceed cost and evaluation error, prefer current champion/CASH.
Keep algorithm source implementation in-house; optional PyTorch is infrastructure, not an outsourced signal model.
Define distributional return targets for quantiles, downside and catastrophic tail episodes with realistic financial paths.
Implement quantile-regression critic or categorical return distribution with numerical checks and bound clipping.
Implement CVaR and expected-shortfall estimates over actual portfolio net-return episodes, with finite sample uncertainty.
Use constrained MDP Lagrangian as research objective but keep risk governor as independent hard safety layer.
Add time-varying drawdown state, loss-streak stress and remaining risk budget to policy input.
Implement terminal ruin/forced liquidation states; never hide them through early episode termination.
Study uncertainty-aware policy abstention and fractional sizing under bootstrap and stress intervals.
Compare mean-return, mean-variance, CVaR and downside-utility policies on exactly matched data and cost assumptions.
Forbid risk limit changes during model training unless separately approved and hashed.
Add crash/reversal/volatility expansion and margin spike scenario sets, generated from historical blocks plus transparent synthetic perturbations.
Model position size scaling under fat-tailed costs, market impact and correlated book drawdowns.
Use proper baselines: risk-budgeted cash/momentum, volatility-targeted strategy, robust mean-variance allocation.
Stress risk model errors, missing observations and unexpected position correlation; fail closed on budget breach.
Require expected tail loss estimates and their uncertainty in every approved policy decision manifest.
Test that increasing estimated risk without increasing expected value cannot increase allocated size.
Publish long-horizon rolling max drawdown, time-underwater, CVaR, cash drag and ruin probability in reports.
Reject agents that earn small frequent wins but occasionally incur catastrophic loss beyond stated budget.
Develop reversibility: risk-off and rollback must work without model state, internet connectivity or GPU.
Create probabilistic transition model for observable returns, liquidity, spreads, volatility and missingness conditional on regime.
Build stationary/block-bootstrap, AR, volatility and resampled-residual world-model nulls before neural sequence models.
Implement probabilistic temporal encoder with past-only attention and explicit per-horizon uncertainty.
Keep agent impact models separate from exogenous market dynamics and calibrate only at observed participation levels.
Generate future scenario paths consistent with positivity, market hours, corporate actions and observed contract lifetimes.
Apply proper scoring rules (CRPS, pinball, PIT, calibration, sharpness) against stationary bootstrap nulls.
Detect model exploitation via adversarial optimizer: optimize a policy in learned world and test it in independent replay simulator.
Use pessimistic rollout values when model uncertainty grows with planning horizon.
Implement ensembles with disagreement-triggered policy fallback rather than fabricated confidence.
Keep train-only model fitting, validation-only tuning and one-time protected holdout for final performance.
Include cross-validation across independent liquidity and stress regimes, not only next-bar one-step prediction.
Run no-trade randomized agent on model and real replay; reject world model that manufactures systematic easy profit.
Validate path-level skew, tail, autocorrelation, gap and spread processes rather than just RMSE.
Introduce multi-step lookahead only if benefit survives conservative evaluation of model forecast degradation.
Test offline policy ranking sensitivity to alternative world models and parameter bootstrap.
Log `WORLD_MODEL_ONLY` evidence status for synthetic rollouts and prohibit promotion based on modeled trajectories alone.
Create counterfactual reconstruction of hypothetical decisions with explicit uncertainty and observability limits.
Retire models that become overconfident or fail basic distributional calibration even if their induced simulated trades show profit.
Define hierarchy levels: global risk governor → desk budget → strategy family → instrument proposal → execution timing.
Build top-level regime labels from point-in-time volatility, breadth, liquidity, events and session microstructure.
Use probabilistic regime belief instead of forcing every market period into a hard bull/bear label.
Implement hidden-state/hysteresis filter to prevent rapid regime flip-flop and repeated churning.
Add hierarchical option-policy abstraction with start/termination conditions and defined time-to-live.
Include `CASH`, `WAIT`, `CLOSE` as globally available actions independent of alpha candidates.
Implement regime-conditioned selector only after global simple selector baseline is measured.
Use policy constraints to avoid simultaneous duplicated momentum bets and overlapping Nifty/BankNifty directional positions.
Add parent-level total capital, sector, beta and downside exposure accounting across all five desks.
Compare risk-budgeted strategy mixture with learned mixture and equal-weight/cash baselines.
Store parent and child proposed actions and risk-governor projected final action in one linked decision chain.
Prevent time-scale aliasing: monthly momentum reward must not influence a 15-minute option policy before outcome is realized.
Lock strategy and regime routers by version during a forward evaluation cohort.
Use regime-specific uncertainty minimum samples; fallback to global policy when regime sample is inadequate.
Test abrupt state changes, overnight shock, holiday schedules, index reconstitution and options-expiry transition.
Run hierarchical ablations showing which layer changes returns after costs versus only re-labels old trades.
Build family-level negative correlation and true diversification diagnostics after controlling market/sector beta.
Publish `NO_DIVERSIFIED_EDGE` if all positive candidates represent one factor with no independent benefit.
Build append-only outcome ingestion that joins forecast, decision, actual fill, mark, realized costs and final horizon reward.
Compute prequential one-step performance: predict first, commit prediction, observe later, score, then update the shadow learner.
Introduce delayed outcome settlement queue for 15-minute options, intraday positions, multi-day swings and monthly books.
Implement bounded incremental logistic/linear model updates and contextual bandit posterior updates with versioned snapshots.
Prohibit weight updates for live-cash policy without a separately approved new version and release gate.
Use sliding-window, exponential decay and frozen-window alternatives as predeclared candidate policies.
Create drift detectors for feature distribution, label distribution, calibration, execution quality and realized P&L independently.
Apply drift alarms to reduce confidence or route to CASH; never automatically raise risk as response to losses.
Study ADWIN/CUSUM/Page-Hinkley style detectors in-house with false-alarm benchmarks on autocorrelated financial data.
Distinguish normal statistical variance from structural change using regime labels and confidence intervals.
Freeze model on holidays, disconnected feed, missing settlement or corrupted history; no synthetic update.
Use shadow-only challenger that continuously learns while champion operates unchanged during evaluation period.
Implement checkpoint-and-rollback with exact weights, feature versions, RNG states, data watermarks and causal outcome cutoff.
Define min effective sample size and independent period requirements before retrained policy gets an evaluation slot.
Log every online update with hashed parent checkpoint and changed parameters; document why update occurred.
Run sequential inference with alpha-spending/e-values or frozen review windows; avoid repeated peeking into same forward results.
Build concept-drift negative controls where apparent profitable short windows revert to mean.
Require owner review and new eligible cohort to change active strategy beyond current constraints.
Import H005/H003/P3 registered methodology and exact transaction schedules from development branches, retaining separate version IDs.
Reconcile H003 universe contamination: reported ETF/MF holdings must be classified by asset class and evaluated using correct desk policies.
Lock point-in-time candidate universe, month-end decision time, rebalance date, whole-share constraints and investable-capital assumptions.
Baseline each candidate versus cash, Nifty 500 TRI, sector/factor matched book, fixed-turnover random books and existing fixed policy.
Validate dividend-adjusted prices, delisted instruments and corporate actions before any new optimistic model selection.
Implement per-name feature vector for momentum persistence, 52-week proximity, industry breadth, volatility and liquidity.
Create baseline book with exact existing H005 top-three industries and 20-stock selection, no hindsight changes.
Create `CASH/H005/H003/P3` contextual strategy selector trained on past month outcomes, not daily prices from current month.
Create rule-based volatility scaling comparison and bounded RL sizing challenger under fixed total portfolio risk budget.
Compare risk-aware reallocations against registered unchanged strategies to separate true adaptive gain from sample selection.
Include brokerage, STT, fixed depository charges, stamp duty, taxes diagnostics and rebalance impact for account-size scenarios.
Calculate net benchmark excess and conservative downside intervals across independent monthly periods.
Store delayed-return reward only after the monthly evaluation period; no credit for unrealized or future returns at selection.
Build corporate-event exclusion as independent testable rule with separate preregistration and search cost.
Use frozen historical candidate runs for training only where allowed; new protected results require owner-authorized trial budget.
Launch shadow-only monthly selector against fixed H005/H003/P3 paper cohorts with identical data/economics.
